I work in special education and I’ll always fight for the right to life ❤️

Our sweet Verity wasn’t expected to make it to birth. One doctor told me if she survived, she would live a “futile life.” She’s 5 years old now, going to kindergarten, rocking her wheelchair and feeding tube and charming the world with her toothy grin. She’s the inspiration for Verity’s Village: We exist to support mamas who receive a life-limiting diagnosis for their babies! We pray we can change the narrative surrounding genetic anomalies from heartache to HOPE!! ❤️
